1:15: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
8:6: Sheol is the place of the dead.
“Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
8:11: A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or about 22 pounds.
